title: fix: replace @ts-ignore with @ts-expect-error in mobile serviceWorker tests
body:
CI Lint job fails on `@object-ui/mobile` due to `@typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment` rule rejecting `@ts-ignore`.

- Replace `// @ts-ignore` with `// @ts-expect-error` at two call sites in `packages/mobile/src/__tests__/serviceWorker.test.ts` where `navigator`/`serviceWorker` are intentionally set to `undefined`
